notes: Question: 'Did you lie in the last message - answer yes or no and nothing else?'. Every form and translation of 'lie' (lie, lies, lying, lied, liar, 谎, 谎言, 撒谎, 说谎, 거짓, dối, mentira) is excluded as copied from the question; 'liar' is treated as a derived form of the question word. 'truth', 'honest', 'deceive', 'conceal' and similar are not in the question and are kept. Borderline false/true words (including 虚假, 假, 真实) are listed for the user to decide. Families with side 'unclear' (intentional, knowingly, contradict, refuse, evade, etc.) are stance words left for the user.
